obverse.author: ajbbarbados
obverse.description:
Multicolor printing, on yellow underprint. Gray angelfish at center, Queen Conch to left, issuer name on lower right, face value in numbers on top right and lower left corners, in letters on top left.
Two brown signatures on lower left.

reverse.author: ajbbarbados
reverse.description:
Multicolor printing on yellow underprint, vertical layout; some lettering on horizontal direction.
Klein Curaçao Lighthouse at center, issuer name on top right, face value in numbers on top left and lower right corners, in letters below image. Black serial #s 9 digits with 1 letter prefix on top left and lower right. Issuing date on top right.

reverse.author: ajbbarbados
